---
title: "News"
description-meta: "Hino lab news and research updates."
draft-mode: unlinked
page-navigation: false
title-block-banner: false
# date-format: "MM DD YYYY"
listing: 
  - id: news
    sort: "date desc"
    type: default
    page-size: 100
    fields: [title, authors, date, subtitle, image]
    categories: true
    sort-ui: true
    filter-ui: true
    feed: true
    contents: news

filters: [remove-stray-divfence.lua]  # This filter is used to remove stray ":::" strings that leak into the HTML output when Quarto's listing wrapper fenced divs are interrupted by raw HTML blocks from the EJS template.
---
